Success final nahi; failure fatal nahi.
Rasta khud dikhao.
"Success ho ya na ho, tum done kabhi nahi."
World mein persistence ka replacement nahi.
"Mind muscle jaisa hai."
"Chahiye kuch? Jaake lelo."
"Future depend karta hai aaj ke actions par."
Madadgar bano.
Creativity khatam nahi hoti.
"Success kaam se pehle sirf dictionary me."
Jo mann mein rakhoge, wahi zindagi mein paoge.
Aage ja rahe ho ya peeche—tum move kar rahe ho.
Eyes pe depend nahi, imagination focus karo.
Discipline mind unstoppable banata.
